title: Bring your crawlers

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study

slide_intent: Use language that connects the audience to the subject, because a visitor should understand who an invitation is for.
strategic_value: The double meaning of crawlers can connect family visitors with the Museum’s insect collections.
demonstration: A transport panel pairs a beetle and circular letter pattern with the cyan headline Bring your crawlers to meet ours.
practical_value: Assess how a split headline can surround a specimen without losing its sentence.

content_islands.name: Invitation
content_islands.spec: Place the opening words at upper left and the closing words across the lower right.

content_islands.name: Specimen and pattern
content_islands.spec: Center the beetle over the dark circular letter field.

content_islands.name: Signature and details
content_islands.spec: Keep the museum name at upper right and small visit information at lower left.
